/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import csv, glob, os
base='/workspace/galaxy_outputs'
sets={}
for strain in ('97','98','99'):
  for direction in ('up','down'):
    path=f'{base}/{strain}_{direction}_ora.tsv'
    with open(path,newline='') as fh:
      rows=csv.DictReader(fh,delimiter='\\t')
      sets[(strain,direction)]={r['pathway_id'] for r in rows if float(r['adjusted_p_value']) < 0.05}
    print(strain,direction,len(sets[(strain,direction)]),','.join(sorted(sets[(strain,direction)])))
for direction in ('up','down'):
  common=set.intersection(*(sets[(s,direction)] for s in ('97','98','99')))
  print('COMMON',direction,len(common),','.join(sorted(common)))
up=set.intersection(*(sets[(s,'up')] for s in ('97','98','99')))
down=set.intersection(*(sets[(s,'down')] for s in ('97','98','99')))
print('UNION_UNIQUE',len(up|down),','.join(sorted(up|down)))
print('OVERLAP_BOTH',len(up&down),','.join(sorted(up&down)))
PY"
